Steam guide: [INTERACTIVE MAP] theHunter: Call of the Wild (2026 UPDATED); its filters show collectibles only for Hirschfelden, Layton, Medved-Taiga and Vurhonga

notes: v2 of collectibles.json. Pick-up collectibles exist only in Hirschfelden (12 artifacts, 41 sheds), Layton Lake District (10 artifacts, 40 sheds), Medved-Taiga (20 artifacts, 30 sheds, plus 10 each of traps, monuments, expedition notes and cave paintings, and 20 landmark signs) and Vurhonga Savanna (5 artifacts). Parque Fernando has 15 challenge targets. Silver Ridge Peaks has one photo achievement (dinosaur footprints). Wand's per-reserve checklists (16 reserves) agree on every collectible count and show no collectible category for any other reserve. On Steam, the only achievements for collectibles are the Medved-Taiga and Parque Fernando ones, plus the dinosaur footprints photo. Salzwiesen Park, Askiy Ridge, Tòrr nan Sìthean and Intisuyu are not confirmed. Wand has no maps for Salzwiesen, Askiy Ridge or Intisuyu, and the Steam guides for Salzwiesen and Tòrr nan Sìthean could not be fetched. Per-item names for Medved artifacts, sheds, traps, monuments and notes are only numbered in the source.
